### 1 — Scene
A mixed raw-vegetable salad topped with pale cubes, most likely **tofu**, and creamy orange dressing.

### 2 — Vessel
A large stainless-steel bowl, estimated **25 cm diameter**.  
Area = 3.14 × 12.5² ≈ **491 cm²**.

### 3 — Items
Mixed leafy greens, tofu cubes, shredded carrot, purple cabbage, red onion, green/red vegetable strips (likely celery and pepper), and creamy dressing. No separate oil is clearly visible.

### 4–7 — Area, volume, weight, and energy
Area shares are allocated between ingredients to avoid counting overlapping surfaces twice. Heights describe each ingredient’s pile; bulk density provides the only adjustment for gaps.

| Item | Area share | Area × height = gross volume | Density (g/ml) | Weight | kcal/100 g | Energy |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Mixed leafy greens | 35% | 172 × 3 = 516 ml | 0.15 | 77 g | 20 | 15 kcal |
| Tofu cubes | 25% | 123 × 1.5 = 184 ml | 0.95 | 175 g | 140 | 245 kcal |
| Shredded carrot | 12% | 59 × 1.5 = 88 ml | 0.60 | 53 g | 41 | 22 kcal |
| Purple cabbage | 7% | 34 × 1.5 = 52 ml | 0.50 | 26 g | 31 | 8 kcal |
| Red onion | 4% | 20 × 1 = 20 ml | 0.60 | 12 g | 40 | 5 kcal |
| Celery/pepper strips | 4% | 20 × 1.5 = 29 ml | 0.60 | 18 g | 25 | 5 kcal |
| Creamy dressing | 8% | 39 × 0.5 = 20 ml | 1.00 | 20 g | 400 | 80 kcal |
| **Total** | **95%** | | | **381 g** | | **380 kcal** |

### 8 — Sanity check
Approximately **380 g and 380 kcal** is plausible for this mostly filled salad bowl: bulky leaves, a substantial tofu topping, and smaller amounts of shredded vegetables. The main uncertainties are bowl size, the identity of the cubes, and dressing richness.
